'''Chad Claseman''' (also published as '''Chad Clasemann''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 26 February 2000 with Bounty Hunting Jabba's Palace deck (no objective), according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d295">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ st-cloud-mn-2-26-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 1 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 19th at [[January 2001 St. Cloud tournament]] in January 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1648">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ st-cloud-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
